ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast bimodal distribution with a ratio of approximately 2:1 white (high-intensity) to black (low-intensity) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: A central black contiguous blob radiating from the median notch, flanked by large white geometric regions on the lateral lobes. High-frequency black speckling and mottling occur at the interface boundaries between the two intensity zones.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Approx. 70-degree V-shaped depression with a deep vertical focal point relative to the surrounding lobe crests.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations extracted along the entire trailing edge. The amplitude of peaks increases significantly at the distal tips, while the medial sections exhibit more rhythmic, lower-amplitude variations.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edges exhibit a concave sweep trajectory from the notch to the distal tips, creating an overall 'W' shaped profile.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Clusters of localized, high-intensity circular pixel groups corresponding to barnacle colonization are clearly visible on the terminal points (tips) of both the left and right lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Detection of multiple parallel, diagonal linear pixel disruptions on the left lobe and isolated vertical scratches on the inner right lobe, breaking the contiguous white pigmentation.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Notable irregular notch and potential tissue loss on the far-left distal trailing edge, appearing distinct from standard serration patterns.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, well-defined dark circular mark (ring-like pattern) located on the right lobe, positioned within the white field near the boundary of the central black mask.
